name: build-system
description: The gauntlet's build_system axis harness Tools/gauntlet/harness/build-system.mjs, Jet's build system against Nix on the axis project, and its Jet twin Tools/gauntlet/harness/build-system/run.jet over the kit's BuildSystem module and the jet_build_system_project package, #5072 c8, both over the repository's own measurement manifest. A measured case needs Nix's network-fetched nixpkgs and minutes per cell, so the cases cover what the harness decides before it measures: a work directory whose parent is a file (fixtures/blocker) stops the setup, so every cell is unmeasured, the receipt records the requested samples and warmups, the stand-in jet's version and one failure, and the exit is 1; the same without a receipt prints only the table; a missing --jet is the usage error and an unknown flag its own, both exit 1 with nothing on stdout.
